notes: Palette occurrences are element-count weighted (computed-style sweep over all visible elements on the 4 live pages at 1440×900), not pixel-area weighted; large single-element grounds (body backgrounds) therefore carry low counts relative to leaf text nodes.

amber-deep #854f17 outranks amber #e8b95e by raw element count (250 vs ~159) because docs-commands is dense with mono labels; the visual anchor across all four screenshots is amber #e8b95e (nav pill, primary CTAs, italic emphasis, logo mark), so role 'primary' stays on #e8b95e and #854f17 is 'primary-deep'.

Dropped from the 8-entry palette cap: the --dust alpha ramp rgb(245 240 230 / 72|50|30|15|8%) (muted text / hairline borders on ink) and the rgba(26,31,56,*) muted-text ramp on cream; both are tints of retained entries.

heroImage is null: the home hero is display type over a radial ink-glow + CSS starfield gradient; the only home images (before/after coffee-site screenshots, media_1d66a8cd... and media_18bac084...) sit below the first viewport.

heroMedium is null: no video/canvas/lottie hero. The hero h1 has a CSS entrance animation (see _crawl-log.json visionCheck) and the sample ribbon '★ REAL · STARDUST · SAMPLE · CLICK ME' is a CSS marquee; neither is a discrete hero medium.

Type sizes/weights were captured by a live computed-style probe of the same 4 URLs (playwright, 1440×900, reducedMotion: reduce) because pages/<slug>.json carries customProps but not per-element computed type metrics. No @font-face rules exist on any page — the site runs entirely on system stacks (SF Pro Display / SF Pro Text / SF Mono with system fallbacks), so type.files is empty.
Spacing baseUnit/scale left null/empty: observed paddings (8, 14, 16, 24 px, clamp(20px,4vw,64px)) do not resolve to a single detectable base grid from the captured samples.
docs-commands renders its h2 command headings in SF Mono at 40px (/stardust:uplift etc.) — a deliberate mono-display move on that page only; the cross-page heading mode stays SF Pro Display.

logo.notes: Raw server HTML ships an empty <header></header> (EDS header block decorates client-side); the rendered header contains an inline 24×24-viewBox amber (#e8b95e) star/sparkle mark of five rects next to the wordmark 'Stardust'. Also present but not captured as variants: /favicon.svg (svg, 1690B), /apple-touch-icon.png (png), /favicon.png (96×96).
